description.en: A published MiniMax H3 example demonstrating dialogue & performance replacement, with its exact source prompt and result video.
description.zh: 公开的 MiniMax H3“对白与表演替换”案例，包含原始提示词与对应成片。

prompt.original: In Video 1, replace the woman’s line—“There’s no way we can be together. It’s not that I don’t love you; we simply can’t make it to the end.”—with the line from Audio 1: “Please don’t go. This time, let’s not let each other go.” Adjust the performance subtly to match the new dialogue.
prompt.zh: 在视频 1 中，将女子的台词——“我们不可能在一起。不是我不爱你；只是我们根本走不到最后。”——替换为音频 1 中的台词：“请不要走。这一次，我们不要再放开彼此。”细微调整表演，使其匹配新的对白。

verification.notes: Matched to the same prompt and result video in MiniMax's official H3 materials.
